verdict: Leads are coming in efficiently, but delivery stopped and intake needs fixing.
narrative: This period you received 30 leads at a cost of $46.95 each — a 50% improvement in cost per lead week-over-week, which is a real efficiency gain. However, ad delivery on Meta went dark on September 9–10, and spend has been running well below the planned daily target, which will limit lead volume going forward if left unaddressed. The more pressing issue is that none of those 30 leads have moved into your pipeline as active opportunities — the leads are arriving, but the intake process is not capturing them, and that is where the bottleneck sits right now. Delivery is being restored and the intake and automation setup is being prioritized this period so that leads convert into trackable cases. Next period, you should expect steadier daily delivery and the pipeline to begin reflecting the leads already in hand.
